nodes.description: Public uint256 state variable storing the constant price value, set once in the constructor and returned by getPrice().
Constructor that receives _price and initializes the tokenPrice state variable; runs once at deployment.
External view function that reads and returns the tokenPrice state variable.
Constructor parameter _price used to initialize the tokenPrice state variable.

edges.reason: The constructor executes and writes the initial value of the tokenPrice state variable at deployment time.
The constructor parameter _price flows directly into the tokenPrice state variable assignment (tokenPrice = _price).
getPrice() reads the tokenPrice state variable and returns it to the caller.

normalization_plan.reason: _price is a constructor parameter whose only role is to initialize the tokenPrice state variable; it can be merged into the constructor function node as a non-core input binding.
